checks.task_description: International SEO Specialist audits hreflang tag implementation on crawler-test.com using Screaming Frog's Hreflang tab, exports the hreflang data CSV, and writes a written hreflang implementation report
deliverables: Hreflang CSV from the Hreflang tab (with Language column and language code data)
Written report ~/Documents/SEO/reports/hreflang_report.txt documenting language coverage, errors, and recommendations

scoring_breakdown.csv_structure: 20 pts — CSV has Language column and actual language codes (en, de, x-default, etc.)
scoring_breakdown.data_and_domain: 25 pts — ≥5 hreflang rows, crawler-test.com URLs confirmed
scoring_breakdown.report: 25 pts — hreflang_report.txt exists, ≥200 bytes, mentions language codes and error types
scoring_breakdown.unique_languages: 15 pts — ≥2 distinct language codes identified in export

checks.score_cap_gate: If report_exists=False and score>50, score is capped at 50 — both deliverables are required
checks.anti_gaming: TASK_START_EPOCH prevents stale exports; domain check prevents wrong-site; language code check verifies correct tab was used
